reviewItem.question: For "The Open Policy Agent authorization (`type: opa`) has been deprecated and will be removed in the future", which environments are exposed? Confirm or correct the exposure condition.

proposed.statement: The Open Policy Agent authorization (`type: opa` on the Kafka resource's authorization type field) has been deprecated and will be removed in a future release; the Open Policy Agent authorizer can be used through `type: custom` authorization instead.
